text:
Jeff Malott signed a three-year deal with Anaheim on July 1, crossing over from the Kings, and the 30-year-old has made the move look smart. He has 6 points in 19 games on about 10 minutes a night, and scored a response goal in a win in Calgary on Nov 6.

What's encouraging is that the process backs it up. At five on five the Ducks have had 52.3% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice, almost 9 points better than without him, and his own chances, 1.06 expected goals per 60 minutes, are strong for a fourth-liner. His 3 goals are right about where those chances say they should be. Last season Evolving-Hockey had him in the 85th percentile among forwards at driving play, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him on the end of plenty of passes across the slot or from behind the net, the most dangerous kind. At 6'5" with 44 hits, he's a big body who also gets to the right spots.
headline: Malott is making a fourth-line case in Anaheim
